finding.headline: "Diaspora Child Benefit Left on the Table" (UK)
finding.problem: "My aunty said I can't claim anything on my visa. But my friend claims Child Benefit fine. Am I losing money I'm entitled to for my baby?"
finding.person: Nigerian mum in UK within 3 months of birth who assumed her visa 'no recourse to public funds' blocks Child Benefit — losing up to £1,248/year.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Marketing angle / entry point for diaspora OS bundle.". Verdict: PASSES.
